seed_categories_hint: Add any missing built-in categories. Existing categories are left unchanged.
seed_categories_none: All default categories are already present.
reset_rules_hint: Delete every learned categorization rule. Existing transactions keep their categories.
reset_rules_confirm: Delete all learned rules? Future imports will be unsorted until you assign categories again.
reset_rules_none: There are no rules to delete.
show_pie_chart_hint: Uncheck to hide the category pie chart on the dashboard.
clear_transactions_hint: Remove every imported and manual transaction so you can import files again from scratch. Categories and rules are kept.
clear_transactions_confirm: Delete all transactions? This cannot be undone.
clear_transactions_none: There are no transactions to delete.
confirm_delete_category: Delete this category? Transactions will become unsorted.
rule_name_hint: Optional. If empty, the keyword is shown instead.
pattern_hint: If this text appears in a transaction description, it is assigned this category. Higher priority wins when more than one rule matches.
no_rules: No rules yet. Assign a category with “Remember this categorization”, or add a rule here.
confirm_delete_rule: Delete this rule? Existing transactions keep their categories.
upload_statement: Upload bank statement or credit-card details
drop_file_or_browse: or click to browse — you can select more than one
change_file: Click or drop files to replace
import_invalid_type: Use a CSV or Excel file (.csv, .xlsx, .xls).
search_unsorted: Search by date, description, or amount
apply_to_categorized: Also update already categorized with the same name
split_hint: Break this line into parts with different descriptions. Each part stays in the parent category unless you change it. Amounts must add up to the total.
no_data: No transactions yet. Import a bank or credit-card file to get started.
no_income: No income in this month. Salaries and other credits are on the bank statement — try another month.
no_income_range: No income in this date range. Try different dates or another view.
no_expenses_range: No expenses in this date range.
gpt_sort_none: ChatGPT did not match any unsorted names to your categories.
openai_key_hint: Used only on this computer to sort unsorted expenses. The key is never sent to the browser after you save it.
openai_key_missing: No API key saved. ChatGPT sorting is unavailable until you add one.
